economics.title: Indicative margin
economics.label: Indicative proxy, not a forecast
economics.intro: Enter your own prices and costs per crop. Margins compare rotations; they are not a financial forecast.
economics.none: Set a price, yield and cost to see margins.
economics.missing: No margin for seasons of crops without prices.
economics.basis: Source: your inputs and the replayed season scores. Margin = price × reference yield × yield factor − cost.
